# Exam Stash

> Previous-year exam papers (ISE and ESE), question banks and notes for TCET IT (University of Mumbai), first year to semester VII, shared by Harsh Verma from IT Batch 2027. Not an official TCET site. The syllabus may have changed since.

## Semester I
- [Mathematics I](https://stash.harver.in/sem-1/mathematics-i/)
- [Physics](https://stash.harver.in/sem-1/physics/)
- [Basic Electrical Engineering](https://stash.harver.in/sem-1/basic-electrical-engineering/)
- [Engineering Graphics and Design](https://stash.harver.in/sem-1/engineering-graphics/)
- [Workshop and Manufacturing Practice I](https://stash.harver.in/sem-1/workshop-practice-i/)

## Semester II
- [Mathematics II](https://stash.harver.in/sem-2/mathematics-ii/)
- [Chemistry](https://stash.harver.in/sem-2/chemistry/)
- [Programming for Problem Solving](https://stash.harver.in/sem-2/programming-problem-solving/)
- [English for Professional Communication](https://stash.harver.in/sem-2/english-professional-communication/)
- [Engineering Mechanics](https://stash.harver.in/sem-2/engineering-mechanics/)

## Semester III

## Semester V

## Semester VI

- [Analysis of Algorithms](https://stash.harver.in/sem-6/analysis-of-algorithms/): Professional Elective I, another option
- [English for Competitive Exams](https://stash.harver.in/sem-6/english-competitive-exams/): Open Elective I, another option
